metadata.method: Manual task/knowledge input, raw OCHA ADM3/populated-place labels, explicit Wikidata locality labels, and individually selected Arabic/English Wikipedia city and governorate lists. Public URLs and compressed source pages retained in research-names. Script never reads catalog or decision output. Duplicate Arabic forms combined; variants do not count as names. Per-area minima are separately reviewed metadata, not inferred from catalog matches.

alexandria.El Hager: English/Arabic mismatch and no credible independently known locality.
alexandria.El Daraisa: No credible independently known Alexandrian locality; Cairo Darasa is outside this region.
alexandria.Sidi Abdel Rahman: Outside requested North Coast strip ending New Alamein/Marina.
alexandria.Nozha Gardens: A named public garden/zoo complex, rather than an independently established residential neighbourhood. Retain Nuzha/Manshiyet El Nozha separately. Wikidata Q23976223? corrected: garden Q23976192; source garden label and Alexandria page garden discussion. https://ar.wikipedia.org/wiki/منشية_النزهة
alexandria.Fawzi Moaz: Checklist names the main street, OSM:way/30644575 شارع اللواء محمد فوزي معاذ. Staged lookup found the street and unrelated facilities, no independently established separate residential area. Smouha remains selectable. https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/30644575
alexandria.El Nasr Smouha: Street in Smouha rather than independently established district; primary bank Fawry agents list locates شارع النصر under سموحة. Remove street-level acceptance entry; keep Smouha. https://adib.eg/media/1031529/fawry-branches.pdf
alexandria.El Mahmoudeya: Ambiguous canal/linear road through several areas; staged response only شارع قنال المحمودية. Not evidence of an Alexandria residential neighbourhood of that name; Beheira Mahmoudiya city lies outside coverage. https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/751770312
alexandria.El Horreya: City-spanning road name rather than independently established Alexandria neighbourhood. Staged responses find isolated towers; existing road/address sources call it طريق الحرية. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexandria
alexandria.Soter: Former Soter Street, now شارع دكتور على مصطفى مشرفه, OSM:way/9929693; no separate residential locality established. Street-only acceptance entry removed, Azarita/Shatby retained. https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/9929693
alexandria.Merghem 1: Numbered industrial-complex phase, not distinct residential area. Official SIS record identifies مجمعي مرغم 1 و2 as industrial production sites; Merghim neighbourhood retained. https://mediadr.sis.gov.eg/handle/123456789/107054
alexandria.Merghem 2: Numbered industrial-complex phase, not distinct residential area. Official SIS record identifies مجمعي مرغم 1 و2 as industrial production sites; Merghim neighbourhood retained. https://mediadr.sis.gov.eg/handle/123456789/107054
alexandria.Manshiyet El Omara: Regional identity unverified: recorded exact/bounded research found Gharbia/Assiut homonyms, with no reliable Alexandria area attestation. Remove pending corroboration; an uncertain identity is not a real known-missing area. See research-round7/nominatim-omara*.json.gz and source-manifest.json.

port-said-region.Mostafa Kamel: Port Said locality not confirmed; Alexandrian district is independent.
port-said-region.El Afrang: Port Said French-quarter identification not independently confirmed; Ismailia Afrang is retained.
port-said-region.El Shatea Ras El Bar: Generic beach extent, not residential neighbourhood name. Source OSM:way/1554277916 is natural=beach; Ras El Bar and named El Lessan area retained. https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1554277916

metadata.notes: 11 requested/attested residential names remain unlocated after recorded exact/bounded and source-context research. Manshiyet El Omara removed from Alexandria checklist pending regional attestation, rather than calling an uncertain identity a real missing area.

entries.research: Exact/bounded search returned other gardens. A developer publishes a similarly named agriculturalinvestment project with JSONLD geo, but identity as the requested residential area is unproved. Its office point and project point were not repurposed. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: No defensible point tied to the client residential-area identity; similarly named farm/office is not sufficient.

entries.research: Arabic EzbetElMatar boundedAlexandria searches and previous lead lookups returned no named locality; one result is the NuzhaAirport approachroad, not the settlement. Original regional place/landuse/WD labels inspected. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: Airport/approachroad name alone does not identify the requested Ezbet; no coordinate borrowed from an airport.

entries.research: Exact and bounded Alexandria searches found several different Islah/AgriculturalReform roads or mosque roads in distinct parts of the region. No result uniquely corroborates the requested unqualified area. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: Multiple homonyms; a point would choose an area without sufficient identity evidence.

entries.research: BoundedArabic/English kilometre34 queries returned unrelated Matrouh houses, Kilo21/23/26 estates and a Kilo57 checkpoint. Regional rawplaces/landuse names do not establish a Kilo34 centre. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: No interpolation along a road or point inferred from a kilometre number.

entries.research: ExactArabic and English lookups supplied no unique named settlement, only a canal-road label elsewhere in the widerregion. Original rawplace/WD labels inspected; no uniquely corroborated requested block. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: Canal-road homonym insufficient to locate the client area.

entries.research: PortSaid governorate indexed material and ITDA register prove Rehab housing inElDawahy. All exact/bounded Arabic/English Nominatim follow-ups and existing Overpass snapshots lack a defensible named block point; CairoRehab and unrelated Ismailia streets rejected. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: A real PortSaid area remains unlocated; no Cairo point or generalElDawahy centroid substituted.

entries.research: Lead exact named locality result is inSharqia outside the requested PortSaid scope. RawWDvillage/mosque points also lie inSharqia; the PortSaid treatmentplant and longdrain roads do not establish the residents area centre. Official PortSaid environmental description attests the area name. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: Do not move the Sharqia village intoPortSaid or name a sewageplant as a neighbourhood.

entries.research: Exact/bounded Ismailia searches returned different road labels, a mosque road and a southern ruralManshiyetElSalam boundary. None establishes the client HayElSalam identity; sourceparents and province checked. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: A shared Salam street/mosque label is insufficient amid multiple homonyms.

entries.research: Arabic/English exact and boundedIsmailia searches plus lead responses returned no named NewStation locality. Official OCHA shiakhas and original OSM snapshots inspected; centralstation identity is not the same as this requested area by evidence alone. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: No point inferred from the meaning of the name or substituted from Ismailia station.

entries.research: Arabic spellings and English SabaaBanat withinIsmailia returned no locality. RawWDsame-name Cairo mausoleum and outside-region public addresses are unrelated and rejected. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: A passing point cannot be borrowed from the Cairo monument or another city.

entries.research: Arabicspellings/EnglishBalabsa boundedIsmailia and the lead archive returned no named point. Rawregional places, landuse and OCHA labels inspected; no unambiguous namedproxy. LiveOverpass residue query failedHTTP502; this is not negative naming evidence. Recorded attempts remain inresearch-round7.
entries.reason: No generic Ismailia coordinate or nearby ward centroid substituted.

documentedFailures.research: Q138196168 raw Wikidata point retained. Nominatim reverse finds only Ismailia–Port Said Road; Overpass names search and imagery show fish farms with a small structure, no corroborated nearby named locality. Exact source responses and investigation are retained in research-gps and research-blocks.
documentedFailures.reason: Reviewed lead decision2026-11-10: rural fish-farm landmark about2.0km fromEG0308 and2.1km fromits ownEG0306 district point. Keep the observed failure, no invented locality or fixture replacement. At least29/30 per area and each failure individually reviewed.

metadata.notes: 30 spatially spread named Wikidata landmarks per region; expected districts determined solely from OCHA polygons. No catalog points or nearest answers read. Individual fixture review is recorded by exact areas digest in personal-review.json; changed inputs invalidate signoff.
metadata.selection: Deterministic farthest-point sampling among named non-event landmarks; QIDs used as City coordinate sources excluded; name-only corroborating landmarks may remain when City coordinates derive independently from OSM geometry.
